title: Lab: one ant's trips (pinned-ant page)
question: Does the strip make it obvious, at a glance, which ants are bringing food home?
context_md: The last of the five readouts. Pin an ant and its cell page now shows, under WALKED, how far from the nest it has been over the last ~12,000 frames, oldest on the left: violet stub = at home, green = carrying food (brighter the fuller), brown = carrying dug soil, slate = empty-handed. Four real ants on the default bed, pinned at ~23,600 and shown at 36,000. The body-size strip is gone for animals to make room (BODY above still gives the number).

meta.checked: all 59 ants' counts bracketed by their tick-by-tick comings and goings
